title: test_kdf.c PBKDF2-SHA384/SHA512 test cases + DESIGN.md fix
description: Add pbkdf2(sha384) and pbkdf2(sha512) test cases to tests/userspace/test_kdf.c. For each variant: (1) known-answer test using vectors from tests/vectors/pbkdf2_sha384.h and pbkdf2_sha512.h, (2) iterations-too-low rejection test (iter=999 -> expect -EINVAL), (3) salt-too-short rejection test (salt_len=15 -> expect -EINVAL). Fix DESIGN.md algorithm coverage table: currently says kcapi=yes for all pbkdf2 variants; change to accurately reflect status after kcapi implementation is done.
close_reason: test_kdf.c: 6 new tests for sha384/sha512 (KAT + iterations_floor + salt_too_short); DESIGN.md notes updated for all pbkdf2 variants
